obligations.source_text: Create and visibly test one independently randomized complex professional-uniform concept: 철도 기관사 / rail-driver operation in an autumn commuter-train cab during leaf-fall low-adhesion restrictions, with the supplied JPEG used only as facial and hair appearance guidance for an original adult fictional subject.
